blocks.content: The motto of the CBI is: **'Industry, Impartiality, Integrity.'**
The motto of the CBI is: 'Industry, Impartiality, Integrity.'

items: Competitive exams frequently ask for the three-word official motto of the CBI.
Watch out for trap options in MCQs that substitute similar words like 'Honesty', 'Efficiency', or 'Independence'.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The official motto of the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) consists of three core principles.
The first principle, Industry, underscores dedication and hard work in investigations.
The second principle, Impartiality, highlights unbiased and objective duty.
The third principle, Integrity, guarantees high moral and ethical standards.
